description: This script configures and starts the kube-apiserver for a Kubernetes cluster on GCE with COS. It includes functions to set up etcd parameters, start the API server, and configure etcd encryption, with detailed handling of TLS, audit logging, admission controls, and integration with KMS.

methods.name: configure-etcd-params
methods.description: Configures etcd-related flags for kube-apiserver based on environment variables, handling TLS credentials and server overrides.

methods.name: start-kube-apiserver
methods.description: Starts the kube-apiserver by preparing logs, calculating command-line parameters, and copying the manifest file with configured settings.

methods.name: setup-etcd-encryption
methods.description: Sets up etcd encryption by writing provider config, adding flags, and configuring KMS socket if needed.
